program_scope: 400+ digital product/service SKU catalog — multi-batch program, internally partitioned by family
user_request: Global Price Intelligence across 400+ digital product/service SKUs; supplier discovery as primary mechanism; upstream/legitimacy/resale as supporting dimensions; output Web Page + Markdown
interpreted_objective: PRICE INTELLIGENCE — discover, compare, verify and structure prices of digital products/services globally with exact SKU comparability and evidence-graded verification. Determine Cheapest Advertised / Cheapest Directly Observed / Cheapest Without Documented Guarantee / Cheapest With Documented Guarantee / Effective Acquisition Cost where evidence permits.
immutable_constraints: Never claim 'cheapest in the world' — only scoped formulation
Discovered ≠ Verified ≠ Supplier ≠ Upstream ≠ Primary Source ≠ Lowest Verified Price
Advertised Price ≠ Transaction Price; Availability ≠ Purchase
SKU identity must be locked before price comparison
Region-aware SKU matching; no supplier geographic exclusion
Multi-scenario volume evaluation; tiers never generalized
blocking_fields_at_start: Product/SKU — resolved as 400+ SKU catalog program with Batch 1 execution
evidence_standard: Claim → Evidence → Verification State; snippets = Lead/Advertised level unless directly retrieved; independent dimensions kept separate (Price Evidence Level, Freshness, Authority, Independence, Transaction Verification)
tool_access_limitations: Search via z-ai web_search (snippet-level evidence by default)
Direct page retrieval limited by bot-protection on some commercial sites — failures recorded honestly as Retrieval Failed
No Telegram access — bot/channel leads remain Unverified Leads unless web evidence found
No transaction capability — Transaction Verification = Not Performed for all offers
seeds_policy: All 73 historical Notion leads = Unverified Leads in Open-Items Ledger; re-verified during run; never treated as current facts
